outer_changes: Exact welding merges coincident vertex indices only; triangle geometry and whole bone retained. No rotation, scale, crop, smoothing or decimation.
core_method: Authored inward area-weighted vertex-normal offsets; u=(z-zmin)/(zmax-zmin); displacement=0.75*(1+2*sin(pi*u)^2). Unchanged connectivity; no fairing. Not tissue segmentation or measured physiology.
units: Source coordinates treated numerically as mm; physical calibration not independently verified.
axes: Source axes retained; anatomical orientation not independently verified.
limitations: Authored core, not recovered source tissue
Bounded floating-point geometry checks, not exact proof
No clinical, anatomical or learner approval
Historical evidence/bone-*.json describes procedural v001 only
